title: Optimize Compact Operation Cost and Add User Control for Memory Management
body:
**Bug Description**
The compact operation is really expensive (monetarily speaking) and offers little value over simply quiting and restarting claude. You should at least give the user a choice to compact or simply quit instead of doing it automatically, it's especially painful when the request is something small but triggers a full compact costing like $2 in API use to change a single line of code. An option to abort and restart would be very welcome.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: gnome-terminal
- Version: 0.2.94
- Feedback ID: 445f520e-9b07-41d9-8dac-6bfd9fca53c7
author: has207
